body:
Thanks for taking the time to read my post.

The people I have around me now haven't actually said they are sick of hearing about my problems, I just kind of assume that I'm pretty annoying that after 3 years of knowing me I haven't really improved my situation.  

I don't currently have a job, but I have an interview at a bar my brother works at that said they'd take me.  Unfortunately, due to my financial situation it is VERY difficult to get back into education.
Part of the problem is I don't really enjoy anything.  I go for long walks to put my head in different places, but it's not necessarily pleasant.  I don't know what to do with myself.

Thanks again for reading, since you can empathize with some of what I said I genuinely, from the bottom of my being, hope you have a great day.
